assignment_rule: Slots express intended roles; actual sources are not assigned until V2-B admission and family-independence review.

slots.target_style_generation_difference: Clean modern vector export; independent organization/vendor; dense GD&T/PMI, compact sans-serif typography, strong line-weight and dimension hierarchy.
slots.why_needed: Stress the known witness-line failure with a mechanical convention independent of H2.

slots.target_style_generation_difference: Clean CAD/BIM-derived vector sheets; wall/profile hierarchy; architectural ticks, grids, leaders, and a distinct office template.
slots.why_needed: Adds object strokes and annotation conventions unlike mechanical, historical, and existing civil families.

slots.target_style_generation_difference: Plan/elevation installation drawings with conductor or tray geometry, callouts, leaders, and organization-specific typography; preferably vector or mixed origin.
slots.why_needed: Tests whether long installation geometry separates from leaders and aligned annotation outside mechanical drawings.

slots.target_style_generation_difference: Symbol- and connection-dense digitally generated schematic with repeated devices, wire identifiers, cross-references, tables, and non-CAD typography.
slots.why_needed: Challenges glyph/connection confusion and layout rules in a convention far from physical object drawings.

slots.target_style_generation_difference: Independent civil organization and template, different stationing/dimension convention and line hierarchy from C1; clean vector or mixed generation.
slots.why_needed: Adds civil diversity without treating a visually duplicated C1 style as independent evidence.

slots.target_style_generation_difference: Rights-compatible vector or high-quality raster P&ID with instrument bubbles, process lines, tags, leaders, and legend conventions from an independent publisher.
slots.why_needed: Introduces line-dominant process semantics and leader/tag negatives absent from current evidence.

slots.discipline: historical engineering drawing distinct from H1
slots.target_style_generation_difference: Degraded archival raster from a different organization, reproduction lineage, lettering convention, and object type than H1; visible aging or scan artifacts.
slots.why_needed: Tests degradation transfer without reusing H1 or counting another rendering of its originals.

slots.discipline: modern engineering drawing, discipline selected to fill admitted gaps
slots.target_style_generation_difference: Modern scan or photocopy degradation with skew, contrast loss, compression/noise, and a contemporary dimension/layout system; not a degraded rendering made from another admitted original.
slots.why_needed: Separates robustness to real modern reproduction damage from archival style and clean vector evidence.

slots.discipline: table / legend / revision-heavy multidisciplinary drawing set
slots.target_style_generation_difference: Clean modern vector sheets dominated by title blocks, legends, schedules, revision tables, borders, and multiple typography weights from an independent template.
slots.why_needed: Supplies systematic layout-rule and table/title hard negatives without duplicating one border or template instance.
